question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James describes its effort including intergenerational wealth strategies as tools advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.
items.quote: That effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, all positioned as tools that advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.

items.text: Raymond James' Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched September 2022, provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors specializing in high-net-worth clients (generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets); as of September 2026 nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets. As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation
items.definition: high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model combining equity and fixed income with an alternatives sleeve (private markets and hedged strategies) to serve high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: This week, the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies.

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry states the firm's private wealth advisor program and expanded alternatives investment platform support advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: For example, our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.

items.text: Raymond James states it seeks to mitigate risks of retiring financial advisors without a successor through financial advisor succession planning and broad services and resources to support their practices.
items.quote: We seek to mitigate these risks through financial advisor succession planning and by providing our financial advisors with a broad range of services and resources to support their practices.

items.text: Raymond James states that generally with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.
items.quote: Generally, with planned retirements, assets are retained at the firm pursuant to advisor succession plans.

items.text: Raymond James offers Succession Planning and Acquisition resources for independent RIAs, including a team of specialists to guide them.
items.quote: Succession Planning and Aquisition: Everything you need to plan for your next step and a team of specialists to guide you

items.text: Raymond James has a 'Next gen advisor strategy' as part of its recruiting initiatives.

Raymond James states its own departments: individuals who want to become financial advisors can gain experience through the Wealth Management Associate Program or move to the Advisor Mastery Program; it also has a succession planning process for roles within two levels of the Executive Leadership Team.
items.quote: We conduct ongoing and robust succession planning for roles that are within two levels of our Executive Leadership Team... Individuals who want to become financial advisors can gain relevant branch experience through our Wealth Management Associate Program or move to our Advisor Mastery Program and begin building their client base.

items.text: Raymond James observed a competitive recruiting environment amid a trend of advisors departing traditional firms and retiring without an affiliated successor, selling practices to unaffiliated third parties.
items.quote: financial advisors may leave our firm for a variety of reasons, including other employment opportunities, retirement, or exiting the industry. Similarly, retiring financial advisors without a successor affiliated with us may sell their practices to unaffiliated third parties.

cells.reason: The passages describe Raymond James' intergenerational wealth strategies, private wealth advisor designation program, succession planning, and next-gen advisor strategy as facts about how it prepares for the generational wealth transfer.
